t: Building a Future-proof Automation Core for AI Workflows
s: A lean, modular Python framework prioritizing local-first, high-visibility, and plugin-based architecture. It externalizes complex logic into discoverable apps and workflows, inspired by Jupyter Notebooks and Unix pipes for linear, observable execution.
sub: HTMX for dynamic, observable UI with minimal JavaScript.
Modular externalization of apps, workflows, and learning materials.
Hybrid LLM/scripted workflows with a linear, step-by-step execution model.
